name: Together AI

modes.label: H100 GPU cluster, on-demand (8-GPU nodes, per GPU-hour)
modes.note: H100 (80 GB) on-demand "$3.99/hr per GPU", scale "8 to 256 GPUs", self-serve, "pay hourly, terminate anytime" (https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters and https://www.together.ai/pricing, 2026-09-28). Sold as whole bare-metal HGX nodes of 8 GPUs (API: num_gpus 'must be multiple of 8'), so gpu_min_count 8 (a 1-GPU workload pays for 8). Host CPU/RAM come with the node (vcpu_h/ram_gib_h 0); node CPU/RAM spec not published on the pricing page. Billing: 'Hourly billing: Pay per hour of cluster runtime' (docs); rounding of partial hours not stated.

modes.label: H100 HGX/SXM, spot (×8 node)
modes.note: Preemptible (public preview, Kubernetes only). Cannot be bought alone: every cluster needs at least one standard (on-demand or reserved) 8-GPU node, so the cheapest real spot setup is 8 standard GPUs + N x 8 preemptible GPUs; this per-GPU rate understates the true cost unless the workload already needs a standard node. Flat discount vs on-demand (not a bid), metered every 1-2 minutes, drain window of at most 5 minutes, no minimum-lifetime guarantee. Source: https://docs.together.ai/docs/preemptible-compute

plans.name: Self-serve (GPU clusters, on-demand)
plans.note: GPU Clusters on-demand is "fully self-serve": "None - pay hourly, terminate anytime", up to 256 GPUs, capacity "based on real-time availability" (https://www.together.ai/gpu-clusters, 2026-09-28). No platform fee published.

caveats: GPU cluster rates not valid for Code Sandbox. H100 dedicated inference $3.99 is a promotion ending 2026-09-30; $5.49 normal list. Cluster reservation windows are not serverless usage rates.
Any null count, CPU/RAM, billing increment or minimum is unverified, not unlimited/free.
This is GPU-product research, not a claim that every feature of the entire vendor documentation was audited. Unverified features are null.
GPU multi-count bundles, variant/region selection and fractional slices require a SKU-aware estimator; unsupported rows remain unpriced in strict cards.

Modes with gpu=null are intentionally excluded, not free GPU modes. Never substitute 0 for a null rate. Flags alt indicate DIY/ML infrastructure, not the same thing as managed untrusted-code sandboxes.
Unknown fee, storage or bandwidth means full monthly total may be unavailable. Rates exclude taxes.

H100 on-demand cluster mode is priced (per GPU $3.99, 8-GPU minimum, no alt). H200/B200/B300 on-demand and all reserved/spot/dedicated-inference modes are still unpriced: H200/B200 list scale "256 to 1,000 GPUs", which needs a human decision on gpu_min_count.

Reserved clusters: prepaid upfront, non-refundable, cannot be paused, auto-decommissioned at the end of the term (24 h email); usage beyond the reservation is billed at on-demand rates. Docs say reservations are 1-90 days while the pricing page sells 7-30 / 31-90 / 91-180 days and 181+ via sales, and the marketing page says 'Up to 6 months'.
The clusters API also accepts RTX_6000_PCI, L40_PCIE and H100_SXM_INF, and GB200/GB300 NVL72 are 'Contact us'; none has a published cluster price, so they are not listed in gpu_types.

fleet.tiers: On-demand self-serve up to 256 GPUs per cluster (H100 '8 to 256 GPUs'; H200/B200 listed '256 to 1,000'), capacity based on real-time availability; reserved self-serve 'Up to 4,000+ GPUs'; 181+ day reservations, GB200/GB300 NVL72 and B300 reserved via sales. The 64-GPU figure came from the March 2025 preview.
fleet.notes: Per-cluster supported size is not account-wide fresh GPU quota. Current pricing distinguishes on-demand and reserved products; account approval, payment checks and scale-review time not established.
